## Design

### 2026-10-17 – October 12: Planning and Starting the Design

**11h**

October 12: Planning and Starting the Design

Today was the first day of Week 2 of Hack Club's Highway to Half-Life where we were on to make a Marble Run Mini Hack.

First I went through the entire guide but some of it was rather difficult to understand. So I then switched to YouTube tutorials to get a better understanding of Onshape (the online 3D CAD package referred to in the guide).
![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-17 at 7.28.20 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/8afeac1b55d315da4bf44e974557424cf8eace3e3c4269d251bb061a6b72e1c9.jpg)

Prior to getting onto the software I'd done a couple of designs on paper and eventually settled on one. Then I spent about two hours Googling around and looking at various ideas. I even produced a few AI images to get a sense of what the Marble Run would look like but wasn't really happy with any of those. After going through various ideas I ended up with one design.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-17 at 7.28.35 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/893e4f885c48d809fbc0546802c7c204d3ff58dbef000f39374f15908100f620.jpg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-17 at 7.28.30 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/b3d732277494d254949fe9e0dfa9bece50c4ab5e87468c166307b425a64b44bf.jpg)
Then I started using Onshape and had a go at making the base and a few models. Being new to the software it was pretty difficult.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 195056](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/788a70ba31a0d15d15b6a21e7718ce4524c01cbfca87c58e23f5e63fdc144008.jpg)

Time spent: c. 3 hours.

October 13: My First Attempt at Modelling

Today I had a go at making it in Onshape. I managed to produce something that looked pretty good actually, just not quite happy with it. It's quite a challenge to make a Marble Run as a complete beginner in 3D CAD.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-17 at 7.28.34 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/d6f48d1d6051448486f37edc03a53fb6ccc2d623267fbd10c2e90c76ee71416f.jpg)
Spent about two hours on it and then decided to switch over to FreeCAD as I was already somewhat familiar with that.

Time spent: c. 2 hours.

October 14–15: Working on the Components

On 14th October I started on the actual bits. Made the cylindrical support for the funnel first. Then watched a tutorial on how to make a funnel for a Marble Run and made one of those as well.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-16 at 2.43.02 PM 1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/dba61929b473bb0b64a46e89fe874d50d5fc5d4a4472dec17a825038edec2cfa.jpg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-16 at 2.43.02 PM 3](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/6229860e87251c0085d0100bd4682d2519278a18a900edfb39bdaf94de52fcd8.jpg)
After that I got on with the spiral track. The marble had to fit inside the track so I had to work out the dimensions and learn how to make a pipe in effect following a spiral. I watched loads of tutorials and tried loads of different designs before I got one that worked for my track.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-16 at 2.43.02 PM 2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/32cb44227d5641e2af298a66a4b0af531b3d36d4a04d4fb7ff441d1a53842751.jpg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-16 at 2.43.02 PM 5](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/49f82b0840470107195a727d76647b3de1f6d0b1b567e7e1b0fc0fa487eff812.jpg)

On 15th October I did the final bit which was the maze. The three main bits were the track that the marble would run along, the funnel where the marble would go round before entering the track and then the maze which was the bit I was free to do as I pleased.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-16 at 2.43.03 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/5e72ffbaae0825572f23311588da8b9e214963b1966bdc1daf346a607039a60d.jpg)

So I decided to make a maze with just one entrance. I designed it and then finally sliced the model.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-16 at 2.43.03 PM 1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/4a2184202ad0740482f799b2d2b5c342a1805e78e4f605040a24b5df7af3de47.jpg)

Honestly those two days took us about six hours in total as we were playing around with various designs and trying to work out how everything would fit.
Total time spent 12th Oct to 15th Oct: roughly 11 hours.

### 2026-10-17 – October 16: Completing the Design!

**2h**

October 16: Completing the Design!

Today, I realized that I had forgotten to make the base!

So, I started working on it again. Initially, I thought of making a base using four squares arranged diagonally, with two large squares and two small ones, all meeting at a common central point. But it wasn't looking good and didn't fit my setup properly.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-17 at 7.28.31 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/20c2a58d20f773e348a58c8b0f68d54fab5a808c4cb904cdfe9a288d6c9436e8.jpg)
So, I changed the design and made a hexagonal base instead. This took around an 2because I had to experiment with the design and make some changes.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-17 at 7.59.12 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/660379d4e44ed8378aa6cf961bcc1ce466937cc86e18e7811a413c440284bcdc.jpg)
And finally, I have wrapped up the entire project!

It was quite a journey, especially since I had to learn new things, switch software, and experiment with different designs. But I learned a lot about 3D modelling and how to design the different components.

Now, let's see how the final design turns out!

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-17 at 8.03.47 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/201256386d2c32c8cf3fa2159059615a3b43550ddfdb8549a49cc349896b0a51.jpg)

Time spent this session: Approximately 2 hours.
